node.title: Re: read/write delete duplicates/sort PROBLEM! - Use of uninitialized value in sprintf
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
m/<x id=(\d*)([[:alpha:]]*)>/ does not match <tagid=...>. If I change the regex to m//, it works.

You should only use most of the [doc://perlvar#Variables-related-to-regular-expressions] like $1 and $2 if the match was successful, in other words:

if ( $tag =~ m// ) { $tags{sprintf("%04d%6s",$1 || 999,$2)} = $tag; } else { warn "Failed to match: $tag" }
